EPISODE 2
[00:00] EMMA: You'll all regret this.

[00:31] LILY: Mrs. Ryan Blake. It suits me better.
[00:35] RYAN: The board meeting tomorrow decides the new CEO. It has to be me.
[00:40] INT. LAW OFFICE - NIGHT
[00:41] HARLOW: Should I tell them who you really are?
